sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 3786 of 2024
Applicant :- Raj Kumar Lekhpal

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Himanshu Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.

2. Heard Sri Himanshu Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Arun Kumar Mishra,
learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.
3.

The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to FIR/Case Crime No. 421 of 2008, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of I.P.C., P.S.- Hapur Nagar, District- Hapur.

sentences.text: After arguing for some time, applicant's counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2022 SCC Online SC 825.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2022 SCC Online SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference u/s 438 Cr.P.C..
The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with the direction that the applicant shall surrender before the court concerned within four weeks from today and in case, a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
7.

For the period of four weeks from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the court concerned, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant, in the above case.
